decision: The later PUBLIC-only implementation is a safe unrestricted view but cannot add an original hard requirement that every real airport surface service admit every traveler. Keep ordinary/default and PUBLIC queries denied; introduce a separately named, evidence-reviewed ELIGIBILITY_RESTRICTED structural result for the exact original requirement, only with explicit sourced actual guest qualification and complete real witnesses.

positiveGuestSemantics.basis: Own official hotel access explicitly offers hotel shuttle; own hotel-category blog addresses hotel customers and independently describes hotel–airport bus both directions. Municipal current transport page separately identifies lodging guest pickup. This is a bounded positive lodging-guest use interpretation, not a claim the operator prohibits every non-guest.
positiveGuestSemantics.nonGuestCounterevidenceRetained: Official windsurf page confirms nonlodging customers in a separate activity transfer category. Its airport destination is not assumed identical to hotel shuttle.
positiveGuestSemantics.noLaterConfirmationSubstitute: The witness requires actual lodging-guest context and reported shuttle contact. Plans to book, unknown guest state, user acceptance of uncertainty, or windsurf customer status do not satisfy this profile.

scopeLimits: No raw operator HTML/map/timetable redistribution; only minimum factual topology and eligibility.
OSM-derived hotel representative geography retains attribution and applicable ODbL duties.
No exact bus curb, public hotel through-walk, private-car suite service, or generic hired taxi edge.
Legal motor carrier, exact timetable, fare and dispatch guarantee are not invented.
Current PUBLIC-only helper remains OPEN, by design. New qualified result is distinct and never relabels service PUBLIC.
No blanket no-public-service assertion or N/A is made; incomplete public-service research is not absence proof.
requiredAuditConditions: Exact airport C28 and exact hotel native identity readmitted
